## :sparkles: Summary

A clear and concise summary of the proposed feature and problem it solves.

## :bulb: Motivation

Why this feature is needed and the use cases it addresses.

## :dart: Scope

- [ ] **Core Functionality:** Primary capability or display feature to add.
- [ ] **UI / Configuration Interface:** On-device LVGL UI, Web Settings, or REST API changes.
- [ ] **Hardware / Integration:** MQTT / Home Assistant, sensor, SD card, or board support.
- [ ] **Tests:** Host-native unit tests or integration validation covering the new behavior.
- [ ] **Documentation:** Updates to README.md and configuration docs if applicable.

## :memo: Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or design rationale here.
